title: Our brand narrative
slide_intent: Teach writers how an opening assumption and a short rebuttal can create a reason to keep reading. The pacing makes the longer explanation accessible.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can challenge the idea that the end of AIDS is already assured and lead readers toward collective action.
demonstration: A brief premise at left ends with the single-word rebuttal “Wrong.” Two adjacent columns develop the narrative, finishing with a bold collective statement.
practical_value: Choose a strong opening and follow it with context that explains the claim and the action being asked of readers.

content_islands.name: Opening
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and provocative opening in the narrow field beside the navigation. Isolate the rebuttal below.

content_islands.name: Narrative
content_islands.spec: Run the account through two reading columns. Keep paragraph breaks visible and give the closing statement a heavier weight.
